how: Repeated calls direct available hands toward threatened features and encroaching lines on an already existing figure.
Participants propose, maintain, and debate changing bodily features while checking references and considering a signature.
Design coordination includes explicitly valuing an unsettled form alongside proposals to alter or preserve particular features.
Progress and rebirth posts report the changing state of the shared figure.
An assumed reference image is mentioned, but its coded passage does not establish a grid, coordinates, or enforcement of one template.
Participants reconstruct damaged features, outline territory, and rally against attacks from several directions.
Night coverage is visible through a tired worker staying and thanks to those still working, without evidence of an assigned rota.
Selective repair rejects a swastika as hate while grotesque bodily additions remain welcome parts of the design.
Complaints about incursions and forgotten agreements do not themselves establish who placed the pixels or why.
An attack proposal is answered with a refusal explicitly justified by an existing agreement.
Restraint can depend on the neighbour honoring the agreed route, with renewed encroachment explicitly threatened if the neighbour crosses over.
Participants broker peace, accept an overlapping pink logo, and seek contacts when an agreement appears forgotten.
Treaties negotiated in chat are reported back to the subreddit as outcomes.
Members propose covering neighbouring art with bodily fluids and expanding a pink body into the Void.
Restored horns, a rebuilding reference, and rebirth do not establish moving the work to a different location.
Survival to the close is celebrated and credited to the contributors who kept working.
Evolution posts, retrospective forms, an image archive, and a final timelapse preserve the work and its changes.
Documentation accompanies ongoing work before final celebration and continues into archiving after placement ends.
Preserving header images and celebrating early flair do not establish a later decision to continue the room or its alliances beyond the event.
The crisis concepts establish defence and chat outcomes but do not establish whether additional placements used scripts or spare accounts.
An allied help request receives assent and a promise to watch its flag without requesting anything back.
Neighbours bring encouragement, request pixels, promise reciprocal watching, and exchange protection for keeping their logos unharmed.
Joint-tail proposals, an alliance protection list, and reciprocal protection commitments show coalition at the model's smaller range.
The survival declaration refers to attackers but does not establish a reciprocal contest with named rival rooms in talk.
A negotiated overlap and proposed joint tail do not establish a host ruling over subordinate guests.
Mobilization, flair, and reflection on art do not establish host moderation of a canvas flood or the opening of this subreddit.
Ignorance of an agreement and conditional respect show uneven compliance without an explicit dispute about who may bind the room.
Inviting favorite forms and saving images do not establish a dispute over cleaning a shared copy or correcting a public history.
Personifying and praising the figure do not establish a separate host-room April Fools takeover or fake-news licence.
Calls for help and alarms about attacks do not themselves establish an explicit judgment of insufficient hands or space.
An attack proposal and expansion calls do not establish a quarrel that existed before the canvas.
Devotion to the figure is visible, but its earlier origin and any colour faith independent of the work remain unestablished.
A single room cannot test the population claim, while valued weak coordination and directed tasks leave backstage decisions about command unresolved.
Political targets and anti-fascist repair do not establish that a tie predating the canvas named or caused an attack.
The earliest concepts already describe work on an existing figure and do not identify its original starter.
Speakers carry agreements reached through chat back into public subreddit announcements.
Moving plans into Discord and returning agreements is a venue practice that needs its own process beyond treaties or coalition membership.
Public invitations and moves into chat connect to returned treaty announcements, although the deliberation itself remains unseen.
Participants make the canvas figure a sovereign with a personality, reign, and repentant former opponent without requiring evidence of antecedent lore.
Calls and later progress coexist, but no coded passage links a specific call to builders arriving and reporting their work.
The record enters an ongoing build, leaving the original starter-to-call sequence untestable.
A report that the figure grew breasts immediately makes those new features objects to keep and maintain.
An encroachment alarm precedes a reported chat agreement, but these endpoints do not reveal the complete defence-to-negotiation mechanism.
The stated agreement supplies an explicit reason to stop covering the neighbour, with the next reply conditioning restraint on that agreement being honored.
Coded crisis endpoints omit evidence linking defensive strain to the use of scripts or spare accounts.
Progress reports and survival celebrations occur, but no concept establishes that reporting completion caused celebration.
Archives follow final celebration, but recording already occurs earlier and no concept establishes celebration as its cause.
The archive supplies evidence of preservation without a coded decision about carrying the collective effort forward.
Rebuilding concepts neither establish a judgment of insufficient hands nor connect such a judgment to moving location.
Reference checking and valued lack of coordination do not establish that a posted template settled the design.
A help request receives explicit assent, supporting an answering pair while its included explanation leaves the general preference for bare acceptance untested.
Defensive calls and neighbouring help coexist without a coded causal link from a shortage of hands to that help.
The mutual-protection statement explicitly exchanges guarding the figure for leaving the ally's logo unharmed.
Calls for work and attack proposals are visible without a coded causal link establishing that recruitment generated aggression.
The reply to an aggressive vomit proposal says not to proceed and gives the existing agreement as its reason.
An attack proposal is met by invoking an already agreed route beneath the figure rather than negotiating a new truce.
Attack proposals and a later survival claim do not establish that an attack caused a reciprocal contest in talk.
An alliance and defensive calls are visible, but the concepts do not establish a shared attacker as the cause of coalition formation.
Recruitment and room flair do not establish a canvas-post flood causing a host moderation or venue-boundary decision.
Treaty trouble is attributed to ignorance or conditional compliance, leaving a transition into disputes about binding authority unestablished.
